name: Auction House
subtitle: get 'em while they're tasty!
rules: At the start of each player's turn, that player reveals cards from the top of their deck until a character is revealed or no cards are left. If a character is revealed, players take turns bidding on the character (starting with the active player). Players cannot bid a number greater than the number of detached resources they control. Whichever player makes the winning bid pays that many resources and puts the character into play under their control. Shuffle all other revealed cards into their owner's deck.
notes: Catalog typo "owners's deck" (card prints "owner's deck"). Otherwise the same words. The parenthetical '(starting with the active player)' is italic on the card.

name: Befuddling Beggar

name: Catastrophic Betrayal

notes: Catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only while ...' templating and 'an opponent's' for printed 'COST – Play this only while ...' and 'your opponent's'. Same play. This image has no copyright line and no 2nd Edition logo in the footer (zoomed crop confirmed).

name: Cheats McGuillicutty
subtitle: wicked...tricksy...false...we hates him
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- The top card of your deck is revealed at all times. -- BOTTOM DEAL -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Put the top card of your deck on the bottom. -- CHEAT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Reveal the top card of your deck. You may play it. (You can't play resources with this ability.) -- CHANGE COSTUME -- COST – Pay 3. Shuffle this card into its owner's deck. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a "pluck" card with a different name than this card and put it into play.
notes: CHANGE COSTUME: card prints 'Search your deck for a "pluck" card with a different name than this card and put it into play.' Catalog adds 'and reveal it' (a reveal that is not printed) and 'under your control'. Revealing the searched card is an information change, so flagged different. (CHEAT 'deploy' vs printed 'play' is just templating.) Confirmed on a zoomed crop.

name: Clockman Pickpocket
subtitle: you can always count on Dick for a surprise!
rules: While your opponent controls an item, this card cannot be blocked. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent picks an item they control if they can. If they do, take control of it and destroy this card.
flavor: Damn...I can't find the third rooster. I'll just have to improvise...
notes: Card prints 'your opponent' / 'If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent picks...'; catalog uses multiplayer templating ('an opponent ... cannot be blocked by that player', 'that faction's controller picks'). Same play in a 2-player game.

name: Counter Attack
subtitle: do you see what happens, Larry?
rules: COST – Play this only during your opponent's turn and not during a battle. -- EFFECT – Attack your opponent. Draw a card. (This effect only allows you to attack once. You must resolve the battle before you draw the card.)
notes: Reminder text prints 'You must resolve the battle before you draw the card.' Catalog says 'You must resolve the battle immediately and before you draw the card.' (extra word 'immediately', a timing requirement not printed). Flagged different out of caution. Other differences are templating: EXTRA COST / 'Deploy' for printed COST / 'Play'; 'Attack that player' for printed 'Attack your opponent'; 'an opponent's turn'.

name: Cute Cutpurse

notes: Card prints 'your opponent' and 'If this card inflicts...'; catalog uses multiplayer templating ('an opponent ... cannot be blocked by that player', 'that faction's controller controls'). Same play in a 2-player game.
